title: Spark
tagline: An NFT Staking application where anyone can come and stake their NFT and earn yield out of it.
description:
An NFT staking application where anyone can come and stake their NFT and earn their NFT yields out of it. The NFT yield is calculated based on the no. of seconds, minutes, hours, or days the NFT stake has been kept.
The staking is performed on the basis of keeping the user's behavior and their need in mind it not only helps to invest more in NFTs but also to earn utilities out of it.
how_its_made:
Frontend: React
Backend : Solidity, Hardhat
Deployment (Frontend): Vercel
Deployment(Backend): Scroll
